note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Medford-Park Falls RD), Twin Lakes Recreation Area. Sites 5-11 are the reservable ones on a short loop above the lake; the rest are first-come and posted for rigs of 30-35 ft. Site 8 is the group site. A 28-ft rig reportedly fit. ATVs and UTVs are barred in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read: 17 non-electric sites (7 reservable, 5-11), $15 single/$30 double, vault toilets, water, 14-night max, season May 1-Oct 15 (manual, matches). Lakeview kept: sites sit 15-40 m above the shore under continuous pine canopy. Count/facilities/hookups now manual.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (not upgraded). The FS page says 'Half the sites are on the water with a view of the lake', but zoom-19 Esri imagery and NAIP show continuous conifer canopy between every reservable site and the shore: site 011 (45.95665,-90.07150) ~25-30 m from the water, site 008 (45.95742,-90.07141; the group site) ~15 m, sites 005/006/009/010 40-60 m. The rec.gov photo of site 011 shows the lake through a stand of pines. Under canopy = view. The FCFS sites (1-4, 12-17) have no coordinates on rec.gov.

SEASON (manual 05-01..10-15) confirmed by the FS page ('Seasons of Use May 1- October 15'). The rec.gov 2027 rate table starts its walk-in season 2027-04-29, a rate season, not a campground season. The FS page's 'Site Closed' banner is the seasonal closure ('the campground is closed for the season'), not a temporary closure.

SITES: no max_rig_ft written - the FCFS sites carry 30 ft (001-004) and 35 ft (012-016) limits on rec.gov, the reservable ones carry 0 (unset), and the FS says 'some are over 45' long'. Every site fits a 23-ft rig.
